== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Azea Farstrider is one of the twin leaders of the [[Witness Guild]], serving alongside her sister, Calazan. An [[Izyrian]], she is described as a tall, slender young woman with pale hair and an unblinking gaze. The sisters are noted for their identical appearance, which has led to theories that they share a single soul or have linked their minds through supernatural means. In her role as a Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Witness, Azea often maintains a silent, observant presence, frequently wearing a face covering and carrying a candle at her waist. She and her sister are characterized by their intense focus and ability to memorize details, acting as recorders of events even during violent combat.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Azea is an [[Izyrian]] twin characterized by pale hair. Their gaze is notable for being wide and unblinking.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a twin head of the [[Witness Guild]], Azea maintains a calm demeanor. They are able to observe combat between [[Champions]] and [[Soulbound]] without experiencing panic.}}
